findings.title: Quick-start diagram and prose disagree on screen numbers from step 3 on
findings.claim: In README.md's "Quick start" section, three screens the setup-flow flowchart numbers 3, 5 and 6 ("Temperatures", "Hot water", "Weather sensitivity") are numbered one higher (4, 6, 7) in the prose paragraphs describing the same screens, because the prose inserts "3 · The finish menu" as its own numbered step while the diagram leaves that decision node unnumbered.
findings.mechanism: The diagram (a mermaid flowchart, lines 328-345) labels three sequential nodes reachable via "Continue setup" as "3 · Temperatures", then (unlabelled-numbered) the branch node, then "5 · Hot water" and "6 · Weather sensitivity". The prose underneath (lines 350-410) walks the same flow but gives the unnumbered decision its own number ("3 · The finish menu"), so every later prose heading is one ahead of the diagram's number for the identical screen.

findings.metric_definition: Count of screen labels present as both a numbered flowchart node and a numbered prose heading in Quick-start whose two numbers disagree for the same label.
findings.phenomenon_property: A numbered walkthrough (diagram numbers vs. prose headings for the same named screen) whose two numbering tracks diverge after an unnumbered decision node is inserted into only one track -- enumerable by grepping README.md's "## Quick start" section for `["{]"<N> \u00b7 <label>` mermaid nodes and `**<N> \u00b7 <label>.**` prose headings and diffing N per matched label, exactly what s1_stepnum.py:extract/run do.
reproduction_steps: Open README.md and expand the "The setup flow" diagram under "Quick start".
Follow the "Continue setup" branch: the diagram calls the temperature screen "3", the building-description screen "4", hot water "5", weather sensitivity "6".
Read the prose paragraphs immediately below: the same four screens are headed "4", "5", "6", "7" because "3" was spent on the finish-menu paragraph, which the diagram does not number.
A reader trying to find "screen 4" in the diagram after reading the prose heading "4 · Temperatures" lands on the wrong node.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: README.md only: either number the finish-menu decision node in the diagram (so both tracks share one numbering), or drop the "3 ·" prefix from the prose finish-menu paragraph and shift the diagram's continue-setup screens to match the prose instead. A few-line documentation edit; no code or test changes.
